title: GMAT Focus Data Insights Practice Test 14
instructions: Original exam-style practice test with answers and explanations.

questions.prompt: A graph showing on-time performance by route in the airline operations sector presents the following data: Domestic short: 88%, Domestic long: 79%, International: 71%, Regional: 84%. According to the graph, which segment/period shows the highest value?
options: A. The value closest to the overall average
B. Cannot be determined from the data
questions.explanation: This graphics_interpretation question tests ability to interpret airline operations data on on-time performance by route.

dataContext.data: Domestic short: 88%, Domestic long: 79%, International: 71%, Regional: 84%

visual.title: On-Time Performance By Route — Airline Operations

questions.prompt: Based on the chart of customer satisfaction scores data (Food quality: 4.2/5, Service speed: 3.8/5, Value: 3.9/5, Ambiance: 4.1/5), which TWO values would combine to equal approximately the average?
questions.explanation: This graphics_interpretation question tests ability to interpret food service data on customer satisfaction scores.

dataContext.data: Food quality: 4.2/5, Service speed: 3.8/5, Value: 3.9/5, Ambiance: 4.1/5

questions.prompt: A scatter plot comparing defect rates by production line across manufacturing categories shows: Line A: 0.8%, Line B: 1.4%, Line C: 0.5%, Line D: 2.1%. If the trend continued, which projection is most consistent?
options: C. The value closest to the overall average
D. Cannot be determined from the data

dataContext.data: Line A: 0.8%, Line B: 1.4%, Line C: 0.5%, Line D: 2.1%

questions.explanation: This graphics_interpretation question tests ability to interpret banking data on loan approval rates.

questions.prompt: Analysis of campaign conversion rates in marketing: Email: 3.2%, Social: 1.8%, Search: 4.7%, Display: 0.9%, Referral: 6.1%. Select the value closest to the median AND the value that represents the greatest deviation from the mean.
questions.explanation: This two_part_analysis question tests ability to interpret marketing data on campaign conversion rates.

questions.prompt: Given telecommunications subscriber churn rates data: Postpaid: 2.1%, Prepaid: 8.4%, Broadband: 1.7%, Enterprise: 0.8%. In the left column select the highest-performing category; in the right column select the category that improved most year-over-year.
questions.explanation: This two_part_analysis question tests ability to interpret telecommunications data on subscriber churn rates.

questions.prompt: A education manager reviews student assessment pass rates: Mathematics: 73%, Science: 68%, English: 81%, History: 77%, Languages: 62%. Select: (1) the category requiring immediate attention and (2) the category that exceeds the target of the average by the greatest margin.
questions.explanation: This two_part_analysis question tests ability to interpret education data on student assessment pass rates.

questions.prompt: Analysis of claims processing times in insurance: Auto: 8.2 days, Home: 14.5 days, Health: 6.1 days, Life: 21.3 days. Select the value closest to the median AND the value that represents the greatest deviation from the mean.

questions.prompt: Three data sources on construction project completion on schedule are provided: (Memo) Overall performance improved this quarter. (Table) Residential: 58%, Commercial: 44%, Infrastructure: 37%, Industrial: 51%. (Email) Stakeholders express concern about outliers. Which source most directly supports the memo's claim?
options: E. All three sources are equally relevant
questions.explanation: This multi_source_reasoning question tests ability to interpret construction data on project completion on schedule.

questions.prompt: Source 1 (Report): agriculture crop yield indices shows: Wheat: 108, Corn: 95, Rice: 112, Soybeans: 103, Cotton: 89. Source 2 (Email): The weakest performer needs a 20% improvement to meet targets. Source 3 (Table): Targets are set at the top-quartile value. Which category needs improvement?
options: A. All three sources are equally relevant
questions.explanation: This multi_source_reasoning question tests ability to interpret agriculture data on crop yield indices.

questions.prompt: Reviewing e-commerce records: Source A shows return rates by product category: Electronics: 12%, Clothing: 28%, Home goods: 8%, Books: 3%, Sports: 15%. Source B notes the average. Source C flags values more than 25% above or below average. Which values would Source C flag?
options: B. All three sources are equally relevant
questions.explanation: This multi_source_reasoning question tests ability to interpret e-commerce data on return rates by product category.

dataContext.data: Electronics: 12%, Clothing: 28%, Home goods: 8%, Books: 3%, Sports: 15%

questions.prompt: Three data sources on consulting project profitability by industry are provided: (Memo) Overall performance improved this quarter. (Table) Technology: 24%, Finance: 31%, Healthcare: 18%, Government: 9%, Retail: 14%. (Email) Stakeholders express concern about outliers. Which source most directly supports the memo's claim?
options: C. All three sources are equally relevant
questions.explanation: This multi_source_reasoning question tests ability to interpret consulting data on project profitability by industry.

questions.prompt: What is the relative ranking of categories in tourism visitor spending by activity? (1) Accommodation: 38%. (2) The remaining values follow a consistent trend.
options: A. Statement (2) alone is sufficient, but statement (1) alone is not sufficient
B. Both statements together are sufficient, but neither alone is sufficient
C. Each statement alone is sufficient
D. Neither statement alone nor together is sufficient
E. Statement (1) alone is sufficient, but statement (2) alone is not sufficient
questions.explanation: This data_sufficiency question tests ability to interpret tourism data on visitor spending by activity.

questions.prompt: Is the recruitment time-to-hire by department above the industry benchmark of the median? (1) Engineering: 47 days. (2) The range of all values is 19 days.
options: A. Statement (1) alone is sufficient, but statement (2) alone is not sufficient
B. Statement (2) alone is sufficient, but statement (1) alone is not sufficient
C. Both statements together are sufficient, but neither alone is sufficient
D. Each statement alone is sufficient
E. Neither statement alone nor together is sufficient

dataContext.data: Engineering: 47 days, Marketing: 31 days, Finance: 28 days, Sales: 22 days, HR: 19 days

questions.prompt: Sort the streaming media content viewing patterns table: Drama: 35%, Comedy: 22%, Documentary: 18%, Action: 15%, Other: 10%. Which statement is accurate?
